topic: How does antenna design influence the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification systems in heterogeneous satellite networks?
consensus_response: Antenna design significantly influences encrypted traffic classification accuracy by managing multipath effects and reducing spurious signals. Phase-matching techniques, which align antenna phases to minimize interference, directly impact DPI tool performance.  This improvement arises from enhanced signal coherence and reduced noise, leading to clearer classifications of encrypted traffic. Higher complexity antennas offer better signal strength and interference management but come at a higher cost. Phase-matching provides an optimal balance by enhancing overall classification accuracy without significantly increasing the cost. This approach ensures robust classification in diverse network environments.
